name: const unsafe fn replace < T > (dst : * mut T , src : T) -> T
rule: If `dst` is obtained by casting a reference to a pointer, its validity is guaranteed for as long as the underlying object is live and no reference is used to access the same memory; reference accesses and raw-pointer accesses must not be interleaved within that guaranteed period.
api: const unsafe fn replace < T > (dst : * mut T , src : T) -> T
